Name: Mineral Nodes
Author: Luminte
Description:
[size=3]Mineral Nodes acts as an add-on to the mines and skull caverns with 41 new nodes.

Nodes correspond to the location of the geodes they are found in.

Included Mineral Nodes:[/size]
[left][spoiler]Upper Nodes(Left to Right, Top to Bottom):
Malachite, Mudstone, Slime, Limestone, Orpiment, Alamite, Thunder Egg, Sandstone, Granite, Jamborite, Slate, Calcite, Nekoite, and Celestine
﻿[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]
Middle Nodes(Left to Right, Top to Bottom): Pyrite, Lunarite, Soapstone, Opal, Aerinite, Fairy Stone, Marble, Fluorapatite, Kyanite, Geminite, Hematite, Esperite, Ghost Crystal, and Ocean Stone
[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]
Lower Nodes(Left to Right, Top to Bottom): Neptunite, Basalt, Star Shards, Jasper, Baryte, Bixite, Obsidian, Lemon Stone, Helvite, Tigerseye, Fire Opal, and Dolomite
[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img][/spoiler]
[size=4]
Installation:[/size]
﻿
[list]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357?tab=files]Item Extensions[/url] [/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Install [size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=files][size=3]Generic Mod Config Menu[/size][/url] ﻿(Optional) [/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Install Mineral Nodes [/size][/*]
[/list][/left]
